population: Compact C. difficile SlpA 15-molecule FoldKit bbox lattices (bbox2)
rounding: Matthews on an integer grid with one-unit headroom above the observed max (floor(min) … ceil(max)+1). Solvent and packing on a 5-unit grid. Solvent limits derived from Matthews endpoints via FoldKit 0.81 Da/A3 heuristic, then rounded outward.
notes: Tighter volume band for compact SlpA-type lattices only. Lattices outside this span will clip; use --scale-mode bbox for general supercells.
Calibrated on five FoldKit bbox2 SlpA 15-molecule lattices (Matthews 7.73–8.96; packing 11.9–13.8%; solvent 84.0–86.2%).
Matthews uses floor(min)=7 and ceil(max)+1=10 so the loosest lattice (s7b ≈8.96) is not pinned at the inverted-score origin; a 0.5-grid 7.5–9.0 ceiling sat on s7b.
Solvent band matches Matthews 7–10 via the 0.81 heuristic after 5-grid outward rounding (solvent(7)≈82.4%→80; solvent(10)≈87.7%→90). Packing 10–15%.
Display-rounded summary-table values (VM=8, packing=14, solvent=84) sit inside these bands.
